annotations.title: Every published trend with its latest edition figures and its first and last edition day

description: Every published trend with its latest edition figures and its first and last edition day. Use it when someone looks for rising topics to name a project after; it answers one page at a time. Every input is optional; `limit` sets the page size.

fields.description: Comma-separated top-level keys to keep: slug, name, category, definition, volume, growth, lane, headWord, whyNow, firstEditionOn, lastEditionOn, editionCount.

lane.description: The editions' lane the trend was drawn from.

since.description: Trends whose last edition day is on or after this UTC day.

sort.description: `slug`, or `day` for the last edition day, newest first.

name: ud_list_trends

growth.description: Signed whole percentage at the latest edition.

volume.description: Monthly searches at the latest edition.

dataset.description: The GitHub dataset holding the same rows.

details.description: The public Unique Domains page about the subject.

next.description: The next page on the API, when there is one.

meta.description: The day of the answer, and the page cursor of a list.

title: Every published trend with its latest edition figures and its first and last edition day
